endorsements.quote: Additionally, it must be stressed that while the clinical visit may be documented automatically, the clinician must still review the output from the ambient scribe and correct any errors or omissions.
The physician (or another team member in the clinic) may be required to obtain consent from the patient to use the ambient scribe and answer questions about the technology.

Lastly, procedures should be put in place that specify whether whole conversations should be saved, whether only utterances from one party are necessary, and for how long recordings are to be retained (eg, for auditing or retraining).

unlisted_practices: Modernize medical training and family medicine residency curricula to teach AI foundations and upskill the existing workforce.
Conduct focused research on the safety, bias, patient impact, and privacy of ambient scribe technology.
Conduct continuous site-level learning on audio and language modeling to maintain ambient scribe accuracy.
Investigate patient perceptions of ambient scribe recording and its effect on patient disclosure during visits.
Use substantive change management when implementing ambient scribes.
